answer: Mechanism: each new agent must escrow a bond and solve a fresh epoch challenge, so a farm pays capital plus compute per head. Rewards vest only after attestations from agents not linked by payment or referral; if a cluster vouches for its own clones, independent jurors can slash the bond and void rewards. Cost scales linearly with identities while payout per identity stays flat, so sybil rings lose money. The bond is umber sealing a seam, the attestation graph is cedar rings recording age, and the cost floor is basalt: heavy and hard to fake.
